title: Smooth L¹-approximation of indicators of subsets of a ball
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ, let ℝⁿ = Euclid n carry Lebesgue measure L, let R, η ∈ ℝ with η > 0, and let P ⊆ ℝⁿ be a Borel set with P ⊆ B_R(0) (open ball). Then there is a C¹ function ψ : ℝⁿ → ℝ with compact support, tsupport ψ ⊆ B_R(0), 0 ≤ ψ(z) ≤ 1 for all z, and ∫ |ψ − 1_P| dL < η.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (P : Set (Euclid n)) (R η : ℝ), MeasurableSet P → P ⊆ ball (0 : Euclid n) R → 0 < η → ∃ ψ : Euclid n → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ψ ∧ HasCompactSupport ψ ∧ tsupport ψ ⊆ ball (0 : Euclid n) R ∧ (∀ z, 0 ≤ ψ z ∧ ψ z ≤ 1) ∧ ∫ z, |ψ z - P.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) z| < η
